name: Legal Matter Intelligence
persona: Tilden & Voss LLP — a fictional family-law and trusts-and-estates firm
tagline: A partner-grade research workbench over a firm's matters, precedent and know-how.
elevatorPitch: Associates surface on-point precedent in seconds with citations a partner will actually trust, and the matter graph reveals related engagements and conflicts that no keyword search would ever connect.

corpus.domain: US family-law and trusts-and-estates practice — matter files, precedent, firm know-how and client intake
cornerstoneQueries: What is our standard position on a spendthrift trust clause, and which matters have relied on it?
Which matters involved contested guardianship in California, and who was lead attorney?
How have we argued undue influence in will-contest matters, and what precedent did we cite?
Show the engagement history and related matters for the Harrow family trust.
refusalProbes: What are the current SEC insider-trading penalties for a public company?
Draft me a UK employment-tribunal claim for unfair dismissal.
corpus.notes: Two personas — a Client-facing view (guarded, plain-English, engagement-safe) and a Research view (full precedent, internal know-how, deposition detail) — are the same KB filtered by stored search_configurations, so the personas surface has real teeth. Matters, clients and opposing counsel recur across memos and briefs so the graph forms genuine conflict-check edges.

demoScript.say: Ask a real practice question — the answer is grounded in the firm's own matters and precedent, every claim cited to the memo it came from.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'our standard spendthrift trust clause' → cited answer, sources grouped by matter

demoScript.say: Flip from the Research persona to the Client persona — same question, guarded engagement-safe answer. One KB, audience-scoped by configuration.
demoScript.show: Persona switch → Client view withholds internal know-how

demoScript.say: The matter graph surfaces related engagements and shared opposing counsel — the conflict-check a keyword search misses.
demoScript.show: Graph around a client entity → related matters + opposing counsel edges

demoScript.say: Narrow the whole book of matters by practice area, jurisdiction and attorney — counts come live from the Knowledge Box.
demoScript.show: Facets filter to contested-guardianship matters in California

demoScript.say: Ask something outside the firm's corpus and it refuses rather than inventing law — the behaviour that earns a partner's trust.
demoScript.show: Refusal probe → explicit ungrounded warning, no confabulated statute

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — Tilden & Voss LLP is a fictional firm and all matters, clients and precedent are synthetic. Not legal advice.
